collection.title: Citroen Picasso C4 Picasso 2016 to 2018 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a the Citroen C4 Picasso 2016 - 2018 which requires a 32" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 28" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button Arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a choice of rear screen wipers for this Q3 which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
